content_text: That does make sense, I suppose I could create a file with the look and then monitor it on set. I have been a little headstrong on doing mostly practical/physical effects work on this video, but there’s no reason not to be open to this idea. Anything to make things easier and less complicated on set right? Appreciate the insight!
